purpose: Fixed-condition repeatability check on one known failure before pausing RAG work, not independent accuracy estimation.
stop_rule: Run this schedule once; retain all outcomes, never extend based on whether they look good. Abort remaining calls if the service is unavailable.
review_rule: Review the actual answer separately from exact-quote validation; paraphrases and unexpected output stay pending until reviewed.
limitations: two repeats per condition on one synthetic query
same seed and temperature are not independent model trials
no claims about production quality or general error probability
